description: This file contains unit tests for the HostEnvSanitizer component, testing its environment variable sanitization and inspection functions.

classes.name: HostEnvSanitizerTests
classes.description: A collection of unit tests for HostEnvSanitizer functions, verifying behavior with various environment variable override scenarios.

methods.name: sanitize blocks shell trace variables
methods.description: Tests that certain environment variables are removed or sanitized when sandboxing shell trace variables.

methods.name: sanitize shell wrapper allows only explicit override keys
methods.description: Verifies that only specified override keys are allowed when the shell wrapper mode is enabled.

methods.name: sanitize non shell wrapper keeps regular overrides
methods.description: Ensures that regular overrides are retained when not in shell wrapper mode.

methods.name: inspect overrides rejects blocked and invalid keys
methods.description: Checks that certain blocked or invalid override keys are correctly identified and rejected.

methods.name: sanitize accepts Windows-style override key names
methods.description: Tests that Windows-style environment variable keys are accepted and retained.
